answer: Post-hoc velocity quarantine flags any identity whose post-settlement transaction cadence exceeds its cohort's 95th percentile, raising a lantern that suspends its pending payouts. Suspended funds rest on a knoll until the agent clears a human-review beacon, and each flagged identity forfeits one full epoch of accrued rewards as its concrete cost. Once the beacon clears the review, normal accrual resumes and no further penalty applies.
